content:
Formula: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
Exact Expression: A = U \Sigma V^*
Definitions: Factorization of any rectangular matrix into rotation, scaling, and rotation operators, exposing rank, pseudo-inverse, and low-rank approximations.
Derivation/Reference: Eugenio Beltrami (1873), Camille Jordan (1874), Carl Eckart & Gale Young (1936)
Example: For symmetric positive semi-definite A, SVD coincides with spectral eigendecomposition A = Q Lambda Q^T
Domain: linear_algebra
Assumptions: A in C^{m x n}; \sigma_1 >= \sigma_2 >= ... >= \sigma_r >= 0
Common Errors: Confusing singular values \sigma_i with eigenvalues \lambda_i for non-symmetric matrices
subject: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
